# Released website catalog reader

`website_releases_v2_031.rs` preserves the production reader before its unit-test module from `crates/host-runtime/src/releases.rs` at supported release v0.3.1, commit `13856abd873da5b4373d39322493b4cc105c4867`. The extracted source SHA-256 is `10122ae6e3844b447e85b5333250dbd21c0dd82b2c0e1d98e4816dcacbd6cd1e`. The compatibility test feeds the current V2 projection into that frozen reader and checks macOS DMG selection.
